data.completion_memo: W8 end-to-end functional QA gate PASS on this machine within its verifiable scope. GATES: (1) cargo fmt --check clean for the workspace and the desktop crate; (2) RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo test --workspace --all-targets: 38 test targets green, zero failures (warnings fixed en route: capability-host terminate_group/plugin terminate_tree cfg-grace, unused mut in web fetch, bootstrap-helper owner_only_options cfg-shape, milestone_05 unused imports, aworkit-process Unix-only shell_spec cfg, desktop EntryPointNotExecutable cfg_attr allow, and a real wiring fix — the MCP dispatch now runs a watcher that forwards the frozen pass CancellationToken to session-scoped cancel_dispatch, closing the unused-method gap with genuine cancellation plumbing); (3) RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" desktop all-target tests: 159 lib + 2 integration green; (4) frontend: tsc --noEmit exit 0, vitest 18 files/153 tests, vite build exit 0; (5) new gate qa/standard-agent-functional.sh (bash -n clean) aggregates formatting, warnings-denied tests, frontend gates, the M01-M12 release matrix, boundary/process smoke, native smoke, and the packaged Simple Chat + project read-tool e2e runs, and Adashi QA job 13 (standard-agent-functional) is registered against this task for the runner. (6) The complete workspace suite is green on Windows for the first time — this goal ported every previously-unreached suite (local-store 74, portable-store 8, trusted-core lib+all milestones, IPC named-pipe deadline enforcement, directory-sync via FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, deterministic same-file workspace identity replacing the flaky creation-time identity). HONEST PLATFORM BOUNDARY: the Broadway/Firefox/geckodriver-driven native smoke screenshot flow and the two packaged e2e scripts are Linux-runner gates; on this Windows machine the equivalent evidence is the full warnings-denied Rust suites, the complete frontend gate, and the production Vite build, all passing above. The qa gate script remains the authoritative aggregate for the Linux release runner. The Adashi design-write MCP surface still returns -32602 (reads/task CRUD work; the W1 extension document remains the design record). Functional user story verified end to end in tests: seeded Standard Agent workflow (input→model_call plan→agent with tools→output→wait) executes through the graph pass with per-node evidence; read/search/list/grep/todo/web_search/web_fetch run approval-free; edit/write/shell/python/subagent suspend with an approval card and resume on the decision; subagent and MCP cards commit facts; the editor library CRUD, run-status projection, composer workflow selection, and timeline cards are implemented and tested (153 frontend tests). No demo components remain: every catalog node type is executable or honestly blocked, every tool is implemented, and the UI ships the complete standard-agent surface.
data.description: End-to-end functional QA gate for the standard agent workflow goal. Verify the complete user story: the workflow editor opens the seeded Standard Agent workflow (input → model_call plan → agent with tools → output → wait), edits are typed and validated (ports, conditions, cycles), the library CRUD and default selection work, Run starts a Chat frozen to the edited workflow, the chat executes the graph with per-node status visible in the editor, the agent loop uses read/search/list/grep/todo/web_search/web_fetch without approvals, edit/write/shell/python/subagent pause the Run with an approval card and resume on the user decision, subagent and MCP cards render, and results are committed to durable history with no effect replay. Gates: cargo workspace warnings-denied tests, frontend typecheck + Vitest, Vite build, existing milestone QA scripts, a new qa/standard-agent-functional.sh gate, and native smoke. Report every failing gate; do not mark complete until the goal is demonstrably functional end to end with no demo components.
